title: Roomkit — 3D room planner for Mac
description: Turn photos of your room into an editable 3D scene. Try furniture, finishes, and lighting in Roomkit, a room planner that runs on your Mac.
socialDescription: Turn photos of your room into an editable 3D scene. Try furniture, finishes, and lighting on your Mac.
socialImageAlt: Roomkit on a paper background with a blueprint drawing of a room
heroTitle: Make a room that feels right.
heroIntro: Turn photos into an editable 3D room. Try furniture, finishes, and lighting.
heroAlt: Cutaway of the Living Room preset with its cream sofa, tiled floor, and yellow chair
captureCaption: Use several angles and one known measurement.
rebuildCaption: Roomkit builds the floor and walls from a point cloud.
referenceCaption: Ask Chat to place furniture from a photo.
placeCaption: Drag the generated furniture into place.
walkCaption: Walk through the room at eye level.
renderCaption: Compare a snapshot with its Blender render.
photoEntrance: The Living Room preset viewed from the entrance
photoBalcony: The same room viewed from the balcony door
photoSofa: A third angle of the room showing the sofa
rebuildAlt: Cutaway showing the reconstructed walls and furniture
referenceAlt: Yellow Togo sofa with a matching cushion
placeAlt: The yellow Togo sofa placed in the room
walkAlt: Inside the room, facing the sofa and balcony door
snapshotAlt: Roomkit snapshot from the current view
renderAlt: Blender render from the same camera
referencePrompt: Put this sofa by the window.
compareLabel: Compare Roomkit snapshot with Blender render
agentIntro: Powers room analysis and Chat. May send prompts and images to its provider.
blenderIntro: Prepares assets and renders your room with lighting and materials.
modelsIntro: MapAnything rebuilds rooms. SAM isolates furniture in photos. Optional models generate 3D objects.
macInstall: Open the DMG, drag Roomkit into Applications, then open Roomkit.
daemonIntro: Run from the Roomkit folder. Leave the terminal open.
webIntro: Use a second terminal in the same folder.
photoToolsTitle: Set up photo and render tools
remoteIntro: Keep Roomkit running on your Mac and connect over private HTTPS with Tailscale.
remoteSourceIntro: Follow these steps if you set up Roomkit from source.
remoteAlt: A Mac serves Roomkit to a phone over HTTPS
restartIntro: Replace the example hostname and email with your Mac’s Tailscale DNS name and your other device’s Tailscale login. Stop both Roomkit processes with Ctrl+C. Run each block from the Roomkit folder in a separate terminal.
serveIntro: Run from the Roomkit folder in a third terminal.
stopIntro: Stop remote access from the same folder.
setupIntro: Requires an Apple silicon Mac, Git, {node}, and {pnpm}.
webProject: Open {localhost} and select the same language as this page in Roomkit. Under {newProject}, enter room dimensions and select {create}.
photoToolsIntro: Install {homebrew} and sign in to {claude} or {codex}. In {photoSettings}, set up {blender} and {rebuildPhotos}. MapAnything uses about 4.9 GB.
connectIntro: Install {tailscale} on both devices and sign in to the same tailnet. Install CLI integration in the standalone Mac app’s Settings. Enable {magicDns} and {httpsCertificates} in your tailnet’s DNS settings.
serveCheck: In {remoteSettings}, select {checkAgain} and copy the HTTPS URL. Open it on the other device while connected to Tailscale. Keep your Mac awake.
heroControls: Interactive living room. Arrow keys orbit or move selected furniture. Plus and minus zoom. Space selects furniture. R rotates. L toggles the lamp. Escape clears selection.
copyFailure: Select the command to copy it manually.
